title: 25 October refresh failure: historical unresolved assertion blocked new picks
detail: GitHub run 40174233578 failed its regression step: test_group_a_are_snapshot_unresolved required 1082858 to have no pick even after the 2026-10-25T05:12:25Z root snapshot resolved it. Reproduced locally: pick_index=1, assertion expected None. The repair binds historical expectations to the dossier timestamp and allows weekly retirement; new tests still reject a changed historical state and invalid current probabilities. This is a test-only repair, not a new source or price. Source reachability and full live coverage are separately audited; no claim that all repository historical assertions have been independently reverified.
